hooks.name: privacy-guard
hooks.description: When a file under src/ or public/ is saved, check it for any network access and report or remove it, because nothing must leave the device.

action.prompt: A file was just saved. Read that file and check it for any network access: fetch(), XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, navigator.sendBeacon, any external http(s) URL in <link> or <script> src/href attributes, or any analytics or telemetry SDK. This product's core promise is that nothing leaves the device: all data stays in localStorage only. If you find any such access, report exactly what you found (file path, line number, offending code) and remove or replace it with a comment explaining why it was removed. If the file is clean, do nothing and say nothing.
